seed.description: Seed of the deterministic assignment; the same dataset and seed give the same split.

train_ratio.description: Share of rows (or groups) for train (default 0.9).

test_ratio.description: Share for test; 0 (default) writes no test split.

group_by.description: Row field whose value never spans two splits.

stratify_by.description: Row field whose distribution is balanced across splits.

shard_size.description: Rows per output shard; 0 writes one file per split. An export needs 0.

export.description: Return each split as a product of the stage (cairn-extensions#6): its file, hash and row count.

register.description: With export: register the splits as dataset versions <register>-train (role training), -val (validation) and -test (test).

store.description: With export: local or s3; unset = the environment's artifact store.
